annotations.title: From the beginning, from the dayes of eternitie.
annotations.text: ◦ To ſignifie that Chriſt taking mans nature, was neuertheles eternal God with the Father and Holie Ghoſt, the prophet addeth that he vvas from the beginning, and from the dayes of eternitie. which maner of ſpeach, by iterating the ſame termes, as alſo ſeculum ſeculi, ſecula ſeculorum, & the like, ſignifie abſolute eternitie. Though the ſame wordes put ſingle, in ſome places do only importe long time, or during ſuch a ſtate: as Exo. 21. v. 6. Pſal. 23. v. 7. & 9.

annotations.title: Seuen paſtors, eight principal men.
annotations.text: ◦ Chriſt raiſeth vp, and alwayes conſerueth manie, or a great number, (ſignified by the two myſtical numbers, ſeuen and eight) to defend the faithful people of the Church, againſt Aſſur, & Nemrod, that is, againſt al perſecutors and aduerſaries. Theſe defenders are the Fathers and Doctors of the Church, eſpecially Biſhops, vvho are here called Paſtors, to admonish them, that their office is to feede the people vvith ſpiritual foode, doctrine and Sacraments: and are called alſo princes, or principal men, to admoniſh the people to obey, and folow their ordinance. As S. Paul alſo admoniſheth: Obey your Prelates, and be ſubiect to them. For they vvatch as being to render account for your ſoules. Heb. 13.

notes.text: The Church hath alwayes true pastors.
